short: use cases, Session, Edition, Ports and the registry
is: The engine's source: the use-case namespaces (auth, chat, message), the Session and its Edition, the Ports bag, and the commands registry.
conventions: A use case is a plain `pub async fn` taking an XQuery or XCommand and its ports as `&dyn Port`, returning a flat XResult struct or UseCaseError.
A use case never takes the Session; the Session calls use cases and holds the only mutable state.

fs.name: auth/
fs.role: status: whether a login is held

fs.name: chat/
fs.role: open: resolve a ChatRef among the dialogs, refuse broadcast channels

fs.name: edition.rs
fs.role: Edition: limited | full; tests in edition/

fs.name: ports.rs
fs.role: Ports: one `Rc<dyn …>` per port, `From<Rc<Adapter>>` for an adapter serving all

fs.name: session.rs
fs.role: Session: Limited (fixed to its spawned chat, resolved on first use) or Full; tests in session/
